lineage.description: Wildfire extent and area were delineated from SDGSAT-1 multispectral satellite imagery acquired on two dates in March 2024 covering Yajiang County, Sichuan Province. The burned area was calculated from the satellite observations and delivered as vector (SHP) and raster (TIFF) geospatial data products.

sources.name: SDGSAT-1 MSI (Multispectral Imager)
sources.description: Satellite multispectral imagery providing remote sensing observations of wildfire extent and burned area in Yajiang County on 3 March 2024 and 19 March 2024

resources.title: YajiangWildfireArea.gdb.zip
resources.description: The area of wildfires calculated in this SHP is based on SDGSAT-1 MSI images taken on 3 March 2024 and 19 March 2024. These burned areas in Yajiang County have an approximate area of 230 km2. TIS raster images of the areas affected by wildfires have also been uploaded.
